gaps.brief_ref: Part C Q3 ("List every place where your code works out today, or converts between a calendar date and an instant")
gaps.requirement: A complete list of every today / date-to-instant conversion, with file:line and timezone
gaps.evidence: DECISIONS.md:21-25 leaves out several places. (1) isoDateToDb at src/server/services/serialize.ts:44 turns 'YYYY-MM-DD' into a UTC-midnight Date; it is used at leases.ts:73-89 for lease and invoice dates and at reports.ts:61 for the overdue prefilter. (2) The default 'now in Malaysia' for the received-at input, at src/app/(app)/leases/[leaseId]/page.tsx:204 and src/components/staff/record-payment-form.tsx:41. (3) The new Date() asOf values in src/app/api/leases/[leaseId]/route.ts:9, src/app/api/leases/[leaseId]/gateway-bills/route.ts:10 (sent to SQL as p_as_of) and src/components/tenant/tenant-portal.tsx:141.
